state.title: naoqi_rest

content.uri: data:image/jpeg;base64,<camera image removed: physical NAO in a shared lab>

part.text:
I didn't find the red ball, so I've stopped and put the robot into rest.

I stood up, swept the head three times, and moved about 1 m forward and then about 25° to the left. The camera only showed chairs, desks, cabinets, a black case, and a seated person. The red items at the edges of the bottom camera look like parts of the robot or nearby furniture, not the ball.

The robot is now crouched with motors off, at about 0.3 m behind and 3.15 m to the side of where it started. Battery is at 73% and charging.

If you can tell me roughly where the ball is, or clear a path, I can search again.
